question.prompt: Car \(M\) traveled at a constant speed for a given time. This is shown by the dashed line. Car \(N\) traveled at twice the speed for the same distance. If Car \(N\)’s speed and time are shown as a solid line, which graph illustrates this?

solutions.explanation:
Traveling twice as fast means covering the same distance in half the time: in half the time, Car \(M\) would cover half the distance, and doubling its speed makes that distance the full trip.

On these graphs, a segment's height represents speed, while its horizontal length represents travel time. Therefore, Car \(N\)'s segment must be twice as high above the time axis and half as long as Car \(M\)'s segment.

Choices C and E show \(N\) at a lower speed, so they cannot work. A shows the same travel time, and B shows a longer travel time. D shows both the doubled speed and the halved time, so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).

The supplied figures draw \(M\)'s segment as a thin unbroken line; the labels \(M\) and \(N\) identify the cars despite the stem's reference to a dashed line.
solutions.title: Double the speed and halve the time
